props.animation_script:
// Bane Oils — generated by tools/anim-studio/lib/dungeon-templates.js

// Re-run tools/safe-edit/bin/_build-dungeon-animations.js to regenerate.

(async () => {

const CFG = {"totalTimeoutMs":9000};

const ASSETS = {};

const ANIM_KEY = "oni.dungeon.slayer-bane-oils";

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][Bane Oils]";

const P = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? payload ?? {};

function tokFromUuid(u) { try { const d = fromUuidSync?.(u); return d?.object ?? null; } catch (_) { return null; } }

function resolveSource() {

for (const c of [P?.casterTokenUuid, P?.sourceTokenUuid, P?.tokenUuid]) { const t = tokFromUuid(c); if (t) return t; }

return canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

function resolveTargets() {

const out = [];

const arg = Array.isArray(targets) ? targets : [];

for (const t of arg) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

if (!out.length && Array.isArray(globalThis.__TARGETS)) for (const t of globalThis.__TARGETS) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

return out;

}

const sourceToken = resolveSource();

const partyTargets = resolveTargets();

const doneHook = 'oni.anim.' + ANIM_KEY + '.' + (foundry?.utils?.randomID?.(8) ?? String(Date.now()));

const readyHook = doneHook + '.ready';

function onceHook(hookName, timeoutMs) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

let settled = false;

const timer = setTimeout(() => { if (settled) return; settled = true; Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve({ ok: false, timeout: true }); }, timeoutMs);

const h = (d) => { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve(d ?? { ok: true }); };

Hooks.on(hookName, h);

});

}

function emitLocal(n, d) { try { Hooks.callAll(n, d); } catch (_) {} }

const scriptSource = String.raw`

// Slayer · Bane Oils (inner script, every client). Approved mockup v3: claude.ai/artifact/H7kodjsPFBHdSeufy2CqNM.

// One script, several takes, picked by the play_animation row's "#variant" (battle-director/slayer-fx.js draws them):

// apply:<species> vial, uncork, the oil runs along the weapon (or is lobbed onto an ally's), sheen

// slow:<species> / weak:<species> the bane bites: sludge drags down / the colour drains

// res:<species>:<element> a ward in the element's colour cracks and shatters

// The gate fires when the take is done, so the next row (the free attack, the debuff) lands after it.

// No backticks and no dollar-brace in this file.

const fx = globalThis.FUCompanion && globalThis.FUCompanion.api && globalThis.FUCompanion.api.slayerFx;

const v = String((ctx.params && ctx.params.variant) || "apply:beast").split(":");

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const target = (ctx.targetTokens && ctx.targetTokens[0]) || caster;

try {

if (!fx || !caster) { /* nothing to draw */ }

else if (v[0] === "apply") await fx.baneApply({ oni: oni, caster: caster, target: target, species: v[1] || "beast" });

else await fx.baneProc({ oni: oni, target: target, kind: v[0], species: v[1] || "beast", element: v[2] || "physical" });

} catch (e) { console.warn("[Bane Oils anim]", e); }

oni.fireDone();

`;

try {

emitLocal('oni:animationStart', { type: ANIM_KEY, sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null, sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null });

const waitDone = onceHook(doneHook, CFG.totalTimeoutMs || 9000);

await game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: ANIM_KEY,

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken?.document?.uuid ?? null,

targetTokenUuids: partyTargets.map(t => t.document.uuid),

params: { doneHook, readyHook, cfg: CFG, assets: ASSETS, strikes: Array.isArray(P?.strikes) ? P.strikes : [], variant: P?.variant ?? null, amount: P?.amount ?? null },

meta: { source: "Bane Oils" },

});

// (animationStart emitted above)

const result = await waitDone;

if (!result?.ok) console.warn(TAG, 'pseudo non-OK / timeout', result);

} catch (err) {

console.error(TAG, 'orchestration crashed', err);

} finally {

emitLocal('oni:animationEnd', { type: ANIM_KEY, timestamp: Date.now(), sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null });

}

})();

props.availability_reason: Choose a Species first: enable a 'Bane Oils: <Species>' effect on this Skill.
props.description:
Each time you take this Skill, choose a creature Species. You may use an action and spend 2 Inventory Points to apply a bane oil for one of your chosen Species to a weapon equipped by you or a willing creature. If you have the weapon equipped, you may perform a free attack with it as part of the same action.

Until the end of the scene or a different bane oil is applied to the weapon, when a creature of the same Species as the bane oil is hit by the weapon, the attacker picks one of the following:

  • the creature becomes Slow
  • the creature becomes Weak
  • the creature loses one of its damage Resistances until the end of the scene

The attacker may choose the damage type; otherwise, the GM chooses one at random.
